issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The bins, the bootstrap indices and the OLS coefficients all come only from train_smiles and train_y. Test molecules are only featurized and predicted. All randomness uses the seed argument (RandomState(seed), random_seed=seed+b).

No bug that would make the result meaningless. Stratified bootstrap bagging of the CatBoost residual model is valid. Empty strata are filtered out. The OLS baseline is added back once to the mean of the 5 bags.

z is consistent. Difference = 0.3711 - 0.3855 = -0.0144. Standard error for one candidate run against the mean of 2 incumbent runs = 0.0037*sqrt(1 + 1/2) ≈ 0.00453, so z ≈ -3.18. That matches the harness's -3.170 up to rounding of the reported means. The candidate is clearly worse, so reject is the right call.

Minor note: the job now trains 5 CatBoost models per fold, so it costs about 5 times the compute for a worse loss. Bagging probably reduces the effective sample size and adds variance in this small-data setting.
